Name: OmniCrusher
Author: mdurham6890
Description:
The golden coconut behavior matches vanilla exactly — the first crack on a new save gives a Golden Walnut, and subsequent cracks draw from the real reward pool (Banana Sapling, Mango Sapling, Pineapple Seeds, Taro Tuber, Mahogany Seed, Fossilized Skull, Iridium Ore, Golden Helmet). If you've already cracked one through Clint on the island, the Omni Crusher continues the same progression rather than resetting it.
The crafting recipe is unlocked when you receive Gunther's letter and requires a Geode Crusher, 2 Iridium Bars, 10 Hardwood, and 1 Prismatic Shard. Processing time is 60 minutes. Please let me know if the requirements to receive this item seem too steep or not steep enough. I want this to feel like an item that you would naturally get in the game, and it should feel earned.

Downloads.Description: Updated the sprite and finally fixed an issue with mystery boxes producing the same item every time.

Manifest.Name: Omni Crusher
Manifest.Description: Adds an Omni Crusher that can open any geode, golden coconut, or mystery box — rewarded by Gunther at 80 museum donations.
